title: FORK · Test the plan before the disruption

chapters.title: A decision before dispatch
chapters.label: THE QUESTION
chapters.narration: Which plan still feeds people when a vehicle fails? FORK lets a coordinator test that decision before dispatch, with a synthetic mission.

sentence_timings.text: Which plan still feeds people when a vehicle fails?
FORK lets a coordinator test that decision before dispatch, with a synthetic mission.

chapters.title: One shared starting point
chapters.label: SET THE MISSION
chapters.narration: This food bank has two hundred forty meals, two hundred sixty four requested, and three vehicles. Each strategy gets the same resources in an isolated world.

sentence_timings.text: This food bank has two hundred forty meals, two hundred sixty four requested, and three vehicles.
Each strategy gets the same resources in an isolated world.

chapters.title: Keep the baseline honest
chapters.label: COMPARE BEFORE FAILURE
chapters.narration: Velocity, Resilience, and Equity express different priorities in a deterministic planner. Ordinary greedy routing delivers two hundred twenty four meals initially, beating every named policy. FORK keeps that loss visible.

sentence_timings.text: Velocity, Resilience, and Equity express different priorities in a deterministic planner.

chapters.title: Break the same vehicle
chapters.label: ONE COMMON SHOCK
chapters.narration: Now vehicle A fails at minute twenty five in every world. Completed deliveries stay completed. Its cargo stays stranded. Recovery can change only the remaining plan.

sentence_timings.text: Now vehicle A fails at minute twenty five in every world.

chapters.title: Measure the recovery
chapters.label: PAIRED CONTROLS
chapters.narration: All three adapted plans now deliver one hundred sixty eight meals. With fixed routes under the same failure, they deliver one hundred forty four, one hundred twenty, and one hundred forty four. This measures recovery against a paired control.

chapters.title: Make priorities explicit
chapters.label: THE DECISION LENS
chapters.narration: Better depends on your priorities. Adjust coverage, high need service, and modeled cost. The comparison uses verified outcomes and reports ties instead of inventing a winner.

sentence_timings.text: Better depends on your priorities. Adjust coverage, high need service, and modeled cost.

chapters.title: Open the actual receipt
chapters.label: INDEPENDENT REFEREE
chapters.narration: A separate referee reconstructs movement, cargo, and timing, then recomputes the metrics. Its receipt checks consistency inside the declared model. It does not prove route optimality or real world safety.

chapters.title: A person makes the call
chapters.label: APPROVE AND EXPORT
chapters.narration: A person reviews the evidence and approves this revision. The exported packet carries the simulated plan and verification. Nothing is dispatched. FORK makes tradeoffs inspectable, and leaves the decision with the coordinator.
